function.description: Cross-chain token search: resolve a symbol, name, or address to exact token metadata across Khalani's chains. This is the engine behind `TokenFind`, the canonical token resolver - prefer that shortcut (one call, its schema already in front of you); reach for this tool only when `TokenFind` is not enough. Use either before any EVM mutation to get exact contract addresses. Its chain universe is KHALANI-REGISTERED CHAINS ONLY and that set is dynamic - list it with `khalani__chains_list` rather than assuming it. App-local chains such as Robinhood Chain (4663) are NOT resolvable here; there use `dexscreener__pairs_search` (symbol to address lookup on the chain slug), `WalletTrackToken` (save a token so Vex tracks it on app-local chains, action:"list" for the tracked set), or `WalletBalances` (the tokens the wallet actually holds).
function.name: khalani__tokens_search

chainIds.description: Comma-separated chain IDs or aliases. Accepts either a comma-separated string ("1,8453") or an array of strings (["1","8453"]) — the two are equivalent.
